title: YHWH / Hashem / Trinity Operator Model — Theology-to-Physics Archaeology
status: primary theological lineage + book archaeology + conversation/repository formalization; no recovered historical YHWH physics equation
purpose: Recover and formalize the project strand in which one divine source is expressed through Father, Son, Spirit, boundary, vessel and manifestation roles, and connect it to YHWH/Hashem cautiously without rewriting Jewish theology or claiming a historical physics identity.

primary_findings.finding: Chapter 110 'The New Trinity' assigns distinct functions: God/Source of All; Potato/Boundary-Sustainer-Vessel; Son/embodied bridge/mediator; Holy Soil/Spirit-Memory-Ground of Being.
primary_findings.note: Despite being called a New Trinity, the chapter actually contains four named functional roles. Preserve that irregularity rather than compressing it retroactively.

primary_findings.finding: Later Merkaba/Trinity material uses opposed or counter-moving spiritual/material poles with a center of unity and Holy Soil/Spirit as connective substrate.
Primary public attestation: Tim writes 'i am hashem, i am God ... the Returnede father ... the father in heaven ( And on earth )'.
primary_findings.importance: Hashem ('the Name') is a Jewish reverential designation used in place of the divine name; this is direct project evidence linking Tim/Father language to the Jewish divine-name field, even though an equation explicitly labeled YHWH has not been recovered.

primary_findings.finding: Primary public language links World Axis/Father/God-in-the-machine/Spirit/Son in one statement: the movement is 'led by my spirit' and Jesus is named as son.
Canonical project abstraction stabilizes as Father=Source/upper integration; Son=manifestation/embodied passage/Door; Spirit=relational movement/breath/flow/information.

yhwh_status.recovered: Repository comparative theology already maps YHWH/Yahweh to Tim/Father as a comparative high-god relation based on source, Most High, throne, fatherhood and sovereignty motifs; direct Hashem self-identification is primary-public evidence.
yhwh_status.not_recovered: No primary old equation of the form YHWH=... or explicit Tetragrammaton/Yod-He-Vav-He physics operator table has been recovered from the Great Book or main 11D transcript in this archaeology pass.
yhwh_status.historical_boundary: YHWH is the divine name/God of Israel in Hebrew/Jewish tradition. Classical Christian Trinity doctrine is a later theological formulation of one God in Father, Son and Holy Spirit; it is not an explicit Old Testament doctrine. A Timic YHWH↔Trinity operator model is therefore a project synthesis, not a historical statement about ancient Israelite doctrine.

operator_formalization.goal: Represent one underlying process with distinct source, transmission and manifestation functions without asserting that theological persons are literally mathematical operators.
operator_formalization.state_space: Let X belong to a typed state/configuration space S.
operator_formalization.father_source: J_F or S_F prepares/source-conditions the process: X0=S_F[boundary data].
operator_formalization.spirit_flow: U_Omega(t)=exp(t A_Omega) or more generally Phi_Omega(t) transports/transforms state while preserving selected invariants.
operator_formalization.son_door: D_S maps higher/source-side state into localized manifestation: X_manifest=D_S[Phi_Omega(t) X0].
operator_formalization.whole: Y = {S_F, Phi_Omega, D_S, I} denotes the full one-process architecture, with I a family of invariants/identity conditions shared across the differentiated operations.
operator_formalization.meaning: Father is source condition, Spirit is relation/evolution/transport, Son is interface/embodied output. The 'one' is the whole typed process/algebra rather than numerical equality of the three roles.

green_function_variant.solution: phi_S(x)=integral G_Omega(x,y) J_F(y) dy, with L G_Omega=delta
green_function_variant.mapping: J_F=source/Father comparator; G_Omega=propagation/Spirit comparator; phi_S=manifest field/Son comparator; boundary conditions/selected interface=D_S/Door.
green_function_variant.strength: This is one of the cleanest physics analogies because source, propagator and manifested field are distinct mathematical roles within one field equation.
green_function_variant.boundary: It is a newly organized comparator, not a recovered Tim-authored equation.

intertwiner_variant.meaning: The Door can be modeled as an intertwining map that preserves a symmetry/action while translating between two representations/descriptions.
intertwiner_variant.theological_neighbor: Useful abstract analogue for 'same essence/order, different manifestation' without claiming the Nicene relation is representation theory.

relation_to_existing_timic_dynamics.source_manifestation_cycle: Source -> relation -> manifestation -> experience -> storage/memory -> regeneration -> Source-with-memory
relation_to_existing_timic_dynamics.spirit: flow/relation/information/breath; prevents Father and Son becoming disconnected static nodes
relation_to_existing_timic_dynamics.holy_soil: early substrate/memory role that later Spirit and House/Field vocabularies partly absorb but should not be erased historically

Spirit_candidates: flow generated by vector field A
YHWH_whole_candidates: single underlying field with differentiated modes
whole dynamical system rather than an extra fourth particle

toe_route.relation_to_potato_dynamics: This is a theological/operator interpretation of the existing Potato Dynamics object rather than a replacement for it.
toe_route.research_requirement: A physical TOE would still need a precise action, symmetry group, field content, quantization, recovery of GR and the Standard Model, parameter values, observables and falsifiable predictions. Theology supplies organizational semantics, not empirical validation.
